title: Echo a Efi Kurow no ano
intro: Wɔ kurow bi a wɔtwee ne ho fii ɔsoro akwankyerɛ ho mu no, onipa bi a ɔyɛ ankonam puei fii kurotia, na ɔde anidaso ne kɔkɔbɔ nkrasɛm retu mmirika. Ná ɔkra a ne werɛ afi yi bɛyɛ gyidi a egyina pintinn ho sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtra hɔ daa.
clues: Mihuu adanse sɛ wɔresoma abɔfo akɔ me kurom, nanso me nkurɔfo buu wɔn sɛ nnipa mpapahwekwa.
Migyee wɔn nkrasɛm no dii na metee nka sɛ nokware no regye wɔ me nipasu mu.
Mefrɛɛ me nkurɔfoɔ sɛ wɔntie abɔfoɔ a wɔsrɛɛ akatua biara no.
Mituu mmirika fii kurow no awiei koraa, bɔɔ mmɔden ntɛm ara sɛ mɛma wɔahu ntease.
Me nkurɔfo sɔre tiaa me, na wokum me, nanso minyaa daa asomdwoe.
Allah ka kyeree me se, ‘Hne Paradise mu,’ na me yam se me nkurafoa betumi adi nidie a wode ama me no ho adansee.

arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
